review.imagery: Forty-one gallery entries comprise twenty-six own-project renders and fifteen historical site photographs. All twenty-two current primary assets, the complete forty-four-page brochure index, eight extracted native resources and every September 2026 site photograph were visually reviewed. Four additional native scenes add clubhouse detail, a lounge, bedroom overhead view and bathroom angle. Generic green textures, feather imagery, lifestyle people and duplicate gym imagery are excluded. The complete street building supplies the card and hero. Historical site conditions retain the September 2026 date and photograph flag.
review.floorPlans: Five complete building sheets show the ground, first floor, paired even floors 2/4/6/8, paired odd floors 3/5/7/9 and roof. Basement drawings and separate detailed developer home-type sheets are absent. Three freely displayed broker images add a studio and two 1 BR previews. Preview resolution varies. No numerical saleable area is printed on these images, and the visible position 16 does not establish a contractual unit number. Confirm the selected home and final area with Imtiaz. All five complete original drawing pages were visually reviewed on two whole-sheet contacts. Three openly displayed broker home images were separately viewed at native size. The remaining broker plans require a form and were left unretrieved. Source images, existing crop boundaries, level pairing, view labels, room arrangements, orientation, amenity legends and whole-sheet notices remain intact. Category size ranges are not assigned to individual images.
review.location: The complete original brochure map page 8 was visually reviewed. Dubai South setting and E311/E611 regional routes are retained. The current primary’s named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinates. Its camera-centre numbers are excluded. The Etihad Rail marker and broad regional map retain transport-planning scope. Exact entrance and numerical source journey estimates remain unverified.
review.provenance: Current official HTML, gallery and September construction-history page have dated URL and byte/hash receipts. The complete branded brochure and six-page floorplate packet are Mitchell’s broker mirrors. Three full home-image URLs were observed in Silver Oak’s openly displayed project figures, independently of the form-gated remaining plans. All originals and source links retain honest developer or broker attribution. Protected identities and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas and numbered-unit matching, basement drawings, full detailed developer home sheets, form-gated remaining broker plans, exact visitor entrance, numerical original-source travel estimates, certified current construction completion and final views/furnishings remain unavailable or unverified.
